Game engine: %1$s
For .cue games, keep the referenced disc files together. An .m3u file can list multiple discs. Optional compatible PlayStation firmware can improve game compatibility.
Sega CD games need the matching region firmware, supplied from your own lawful console files. Keep .cue games with their referenced disc files.
Atari Lynx requires the lynxboot.img firmware file from a lawful source.
Nintendo DS uses two screens and touch controls. Firmware needs depend on the selected game engine.
Arcade .zip files are compatible game sets, not ordinary single-game ZIP archives. They must match the arcade engine version.
DOS games use .dosz archives. Controls and compatibility vary between games.
The .bin ending is shared by different systems. Keep game files in appropriately named folders so CARTDECK can identify them.
